chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Everything that chews the cud—its leftover water is halal (permissible), and its saliva is halal (permissible)."

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the source of this prophetic ruling
key_terms.سُؤْرُهُ: Its leftover water or the remainder of what it has drunk from
key_terms.يَجْتَرُّ: Chews the cud; referring to ruminant animals

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the leftover water and saliva of animals that chew the cud?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله concerning animals that chew the cud. It states that the leftover water they drink from and their saliva are halal (permissible), indicating their purity in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.9 - The Messenger of Allah (sw), said:
"Everything that chews the cud—its leftover water and saliva are permissible."
